title: Hitler to Neil Armstrong: how?
description: Five real photos connect Adolf Hitler to Neil Armstrong.
hook: What links Hitler to Neil Armstrong?

links.line: In 1941, Hitler hosted Japan's foreign minister, Yosuke Matsuoka, in Berlin.

image.file: File:Matsuoka signs the Soviet–Japanese Neutrality Pact-1.jpg

links.line: Weeks later, Matsuoka signed a pact in Moscow as Joseph Stalin watched.
In 1949, Mao Zedong came to Moscow for Stalin's seventieth birthday.

image.file: File:President Richard Nixon and Mao Zedong.jpg

links.line: In 1972, Richard Nixon flew to China to meet Mao.

image.file: File:President Nixon welcomes the Apollo 11 astronauts aboard the U.S.S. Hornet.jpg

links.line: Back in 1969, Nixon welcomed home the first man on the Moon, Neil Armstrong.
